name: steam-file-transfer
description: 같은 내부망의 Steam 기기(SteamOS/Windows/macOS) 사이에서 게임 폴더에 패치 파일을 덮어쓰는 P2P 전송 도구
author: ddukbaek2

scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/check-deploy.mjs && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && node scripts/check-deploy.mjs && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && node scripts/check-deploy.mjs && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:all: npm run build && node scripts/check-deploy.mjs && electron-builder --linux && electron-builder --win
scripts.e2e: npm run build && node scripts/build-tests.mjs && node scripts/e2e.mjs
